description_en: Calls ModifyWhiteIps to update the access whitelist of a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyWhiteIps，更新指定实例的访问白名单
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch modify-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-0pp1jxvcl000z0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --node-type WORKER --network-type PUBLIC --modify-mode Cover --white-ip-list 192.168.xx.xx --white-ip-group '{"groupName":"test_group","whiteIpType":"PRIVATE_ES","ips":["192.168.xx.xx"]}' --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWhiteIps

parameters.help_en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ascii字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The node type. This parameter is required if whiteIpList is specified. Valid values:

- WORKER: Elasticsearch cluster.
- KIBANA: Kibana cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，如果选填了whiteIpList参数，则该参数必填。可选值：

- WORKER：Elasticsearch集群
- KIBANA：Kibana集群
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type. This parameter is required if whiteIpList is specified. Valid values:

- PRIVATE: private network.
- PUBLIC: public network
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型，如果选填了whiteIpList参数，则该参数必填。可选值：

- PRIVATE：私网
- PUBLIC：公网
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode. Valid values:

- Cover (default): Overwrites the original IP whitelist with the value of the ips parameter.
- Append: Adds the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter to the original IP whitelist.
- Delete: Removes the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter from the original IP whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained
parameters.help_zh:
修改方式，可选值：

- Cover（默认）：使用ips参数的值覆盖原IP白名单。
- Append：在原IP白名单中增加ips参数中输入的IP地址。
- Delete：在原IP白名单中删除ips参数中输入的IP地址，至少需要保留一个IP地址
parameters.name: modify_mode

parameters.help_en: The IP address whitelist. This parameter is available when whiteIpGroup is empty and updates the default group whitelist
parameters.help_zh: IP地址白名单列表。whiteIpGroup为空时可用，更改默认分组白名单
parameters.name: white_ip_list

fields.help_en: The name of the whitelist group. This parameter is required if whiteIpGroup is specified
fields.help_zh: 白名单组的组名。如果选填了whiteIpGroup参数，则该参数必填
fields.name: group_name

fields.help_en: The list of IP addresses in the whitelist group. This parameter is required if whiteIpGroup is specified
fields.help_zh: 白名单组中的IP地址列表。如果选填了whiteIpGroup参数，则该参数必填
fields.name: ips

fields.help_en:
The type of the IP whitelist. Valid values:

- PRIVATE_KIBANA: Kibana private access whitelist.
- PRIVATE_ES: Elasticsearch private access whitelist.
- PUBLIC_ES: Elasticsearch public access whitelist.
- PUBLIC_KIBANA: Kibana public access whitelist
fields.help_zh:
IP白名单的类型，可选值：

- PRIVATE_KIBANA：Kibana私网访问白名单
- PRIVATE_ES：Elasticsearch私网访问白名单
- PUBLIC_ES：Elasticsearch公网访问白名单
- PUBLIC_KIBANA：Kibana公网访问白名单
fields.name: white_ip_type

parameters.help_en:
Updates the instance whitelist configuration by using the whitelist group method. Only one whitelist group can be updated at a time.
><notice>You cannot configure whiteIpList and whiteIpGroup at the same time.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
以白名单组方式更新实例白名单配置，仅支持更新一个白名单组。
><notice>不支持同时配置whiteIpList和whiteIpGroup。
></notice>
parameters.name: white_ip_group
